newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rise on blue-chip buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rise on blue-chip buying.

text.p: Tokyo stocks gained ground in early morning trade on Wednesday as participants bought international blue chips and some pharmaceutical issues, brokers said.
As of 0017 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average was up 162.61 points, or 0.89 percent, at 18,343.78. Its March futures were 120 points higher at 18,320.

"Although certain issues in the banking and construction sectors have been losing ground due to worries about their financial health, overall sentiment has been encouraged by the weaker yen," a dealer at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
Blue chips attracting interest included Toyota Motor Co and Canon Inc. The pharmaceutical issues included Sankyo Co Ltd and Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd.
